newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M continues to soar on split talk, Q4.
newsitem.headline: H&M continues to soar on split talk, Q4.

text.p: Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz continued to surge on Tuesday morning after posting strong gains on Monday amid market rumours of a share split and ahead of the fourth quarter results report.
At 0945 GMT H&M shares had jumped 55 crowns to 1,120, an all-time intraday high.
On Monday the retailer jumped 55 crowns to a new closing high of 1,065 crowns.

"There is some short covering coming out ahead of the fourth quarter earnings report that will be published on January 30," said one broker. "The report could be stronger than was expected so people are taking positions now.
"There is also some speculation about a stocks split."
